name: zhud_zrd_widget_ex17c_destructor_core
description: HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C::DestructorCore reinstalls the selector vtable, scalar-deletes owned option items, clears option slots, and tears down the base ZRD widget.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b8b60 validates vtable reinstall to g_HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Vtbl, a fixed 10-slot loop over options at offset 0x150, scalar-deleting each non-null item through slot 0 with flag 1, nulling each deleted slot, then calling HudUiZrdWidget::DestructorCore.

The native smoke verifies constructor-cleared option slots, loaded selector ownership/selection setup, DestructorCore nulling a heap-owned option slot, and base teardown back to the common HUD widget vtable.
